title: And why no other children born?
html_source: There is no record of Shakespeare or Hathaway having any children after 1585.

anchor.text: And why no other children born?
anchor.prefix:
terlinck. Abbey Theatre! I smell the pubic sweat of monks. 

 He spat blank. 

 Forgot: any more than he forgot the whipping lousy Lucy gave him. And left the femme de trente ans.
anchor.suffix:
And his first child a girl? 

 Afterwit. Go back. 

 The dour recluse still there (he has his cake) and the douce youngling, minion of pleasure, Phedo's toyable fair hair.
